exec drivebridge
stdout 'Usage: drivebridge'
mkdir local
exec drivebridge space-add --state $WORK/state --space creative --remote one --drive-id drive --root-id root --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576
stdout 'Space configured'
exec drivebridge capabilities --state $WORK/state --json
stdout '"enabled":false'
stdout '"id":"creative"'
! exec drivebridge space-add --state $WORK/state --space creative --remote two --drive-id other --root-id root --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576
stderr 'DriveBridge failed'
